$ tcpdump -nn -A -r capture.pcap 'tcp port 80' | grep -aE 'Authorization|Cookie|email'
Authorization: Basic ZGVtbzpodW50ZXIy
Cookie: session=7f3c9a1e5b
{"order":42,"email":"customer@example.com","total":"19.99"}

$ tcpdump -nn -r capture.pcap 'tcp port 80' | wc -l
7
$ tcpdump -nn -r capture.pcap 'host 203.0.113.7' | wc -l
2
$ tcpdump -nn -r capture.pcap 'udp port 53' | wc -l
2
$ tcpdump -nn -r capture.pcap 'net 198.51.100.0/24' | wc -l
11
$ tcpdump -nn -r capture.pcap 'not port 443' | wc -l
11

$ node make-capture.mjs bulk.pcap 2500 && ls -l bulk.pcap
